reason: E2 states that Si-containing additives facilitate consolidation, improve oxidation resistance, and improve mechanical properties of transition metal borides, supporting the first three premises. However, the specific claims about a transient liquid phase at ~1600 °C and the formation of a protective SiO2 layer at grain boundaries are not directly evidenced in the cited passages; E1 discusses a different coating system and does not address these mechanisms. Thus, the key mechanistic premises lack direct support.
premises: Si-containing additives facilitate consolidation of difficult-to-sinter transition metal boride powders
Si-containing additives improve oxidation resistance of transition metal borides
Si-containing additives improve mechanical properties of transition metal borides
A transient liquid phase from Si doping can enable densification at ~1600 °C
A protective SiO2 layer forms at grain boundaries and inhibits oxidation and liquid-metal corrosion
